DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20261017 (Max) now leads open-weight models on Code Arena’s WebDev board, ahead of Kimi K3 (Max).

The pricing is hard to ignore: Arena lists $0.30/$1.20 per million input/output tokens for Flash, versus $3/$15 for K3. If you’re iterating on landing pages or prototypes, that makes Flash worth testing. Kimi’s next release has a tougher bar to clear.
